1	"""Persistent storage: blockchain, pending set and derived indexes (JSON).
2	
3	The whole state is one JSON document written atomically: a uniquely named
4	``.ledger-*`` snapshot is fsynced in the same directory and then promoted over
5	the main file with ``os.replace`` (followed by a directory fsync). Every
6	successful write advances a monotonic ``generation`` recorded in the
7	snapshot. A crash can therefore only leave behind (a) the previous main file
8	or (b) a fully fsynced snapshot that never got renamed — never a torn file.
9	
10	On startup the main file and every sibling ``.ledger-*`` snapshot are treated
11	as recovery candidates. When no file exists at all, the unique genesis block
12	is created; otherwise each candidate is strictly validated (JSON, generation,
13	consecutive heights, prev_hash linkage, recomputed block hashes and Merkle
14	roots, per-transaction tx_id and Ed25519 signature, pending-only-at-tip and
15	mempool/chain de-duplication). The valid snapshot with the highest generation
16	wins and is promoted if it is still a temp file; same-generation content
17	conflicts, or a directory with no valid candidate, raise StateRecoveryError
18	with the offending path and reason — a fresh chain is never silently created.
19	
20	One atomic write persists everything: the chain (each block carries its
21	confirm/rollback ``status``), a small ``state`` summary, the mempool
22	(``pending``), candidate fork chains (``forks``, each a full block list
23	anchored at the canonical genesis and keyed by its tip hash), the
24	confirmed-transaction ``index`` and the confirmed ``accounts`` activity.
25	Derived data (index/accounts) is *rebuilt* from the chain on every load and
26	every save — pending blocks are excluded, so a restart never resurrects
27	unconfirmed transactions into balances. Persisted fork candidates are
28	re-validated on startup and invalid ones are dropped, while canonical-chain
29	invalidity remains fatal. A re-entrant lock serializes all updates, and a
30	class-wide recovery lock serializes startup scans against in-flight writes.
31	"""
32	from __future__ import annotations
33	
34	import json
35	import os
36	import tempfile
37	import threading
38	
39	from .models import (
40	    STATUS_CONFIRMED,
41	    STATUS_PENDING,
42	    Block,
43	    Transaction,
44	    compute_block_hash,
45	)
46	from . import crypto
47	
48	# Previous hash of the genesis block.
49	GENESIS_PREV_HASH = "0" * 64
50	
51	# On-disk schema version, stored under "state" so future migrations are possible.
52	STATE_VERSION = 4
53	
54	# Prefix of durable snapshot temp files ("<state>.ledger-<...>") living next to
55	# the main state file. They double as crash-recovery candidates on startup.
56	SNAPSHOT_PREFIX = ".ledger-"

59	class StateRecoveryError(ValueError):
60	    """Raised when no usable on-disk state can be recovered on startup.
61	
62	    Carries the candidate ``path`` that failed and a human-readable ``reason``
63	    so callers can report (or catch) the failure explicitly. The exception is a
64	    ``ValueError`` subclass, so older callers expecting ``ValueError`` on a
65	    corrupt state file keep working.

69	        self.path = path

158	
159	            # Identical same-generation snapshots: keep the main file when it
160	            # is one of them, avoiding a pointless promotion cycle.
161	            main_abs = os.path.abspath(self.path)
162	            winner = top[0]
163	            for item in top:
164	                if os.path.abspath(item[1]) == main_abs:
165	                    winner = item
166	                    break
167	            generation, winner_path, chain, pending, forks, winner_init_balance = winner
168	
169	            if os.path.abspath(winner_path) != main_abs:
170	                # The newest durable state only ever made it to a temp
171	                # snapshot (a crash interrupted the promotion): promote it.
172	                os.replace(winner_path, self.path)
173	                self._fsync_dir(directory)
174	
175	            self.chain = chain
176	            self.pending = pending
177	            self.forks = forks
178	            self.generation = generation
179	            # Prefer the endowment recorded by the writer; fall back to the
180	            # value this instance was constructed with, and finally to the
181	            # service default, so older snapshots without the field still
182	            # validate fork replays against the configured endowment.
183	            if winner_init_balance is not None:
184	                self.initial_balance = winner_init_balance
185	            self.rebuild_derived()
186	            self._cleanup_candidates(directory)

188	    def _discover_candidates(self, directory: str) -> list[str]:
189	        """List the main file and sibling .ledger-* snapshots (if any)."""
190	        candidates: list[str] = []
191	        if os.path.exists(self.path):
192	            candidates.append(self.path)
193	        try:
194	            names = sorted(os.listdir(directory))
195	        except OSError:
196	            return candidates
197	        main_name = os.path.basename(self.path)
198	        for name in names:
199	            if name == main_name or not name.startswith(SNAPSHOT_PREFIX):
200	                continue
201	            full = os.path.join(directory, name)
202	            if os.path.isfile(full):
203	                candidates.append(full)
204	        return candidates

207	    def _canonical_view(
208	        chain: list[Block],
209	        pending: dict[str, Transaction],
210	        forks: dict[str, list[Block]],
211	    ) -> str:
212	        """Order-independent canonical content hash for conflict detection."""
213	        return json.dumps(
214	            {
215	                "chain": [block.to_dict() for block in chain],
216	                "pending": [pending[tx_id].to_dict() for tx_id in sorted(pending)],
217	                "forks": [
218	                    [block.to_dict() for block in forks[tip]]

226	    def _cleanup_candidates(self, directory: str) -> None:
227	        """Remove every residual .ledger-* snapshot next to the main file.
228	
229	        After recovery these are by definition unusable leftovers: older
230	        generations, an identical post-promotion residue, or a partially
231	        written (invalid) file. The promoted/main state is never touched.
232	        """
233	        main_name = os.path.basename(self.path)
234	        for name in list(os.listdir(directory)):
235	            if not name.startswith(SNAPSHOT_PREFIX) or name == main_name:
236	                continue
237	            full = os.path.join(directory, name)
238	            try:
239	                if os.path.isfile(full) or os.path.islink(full):
240	                    os.unlink(full)
241	            except OSError:
242	                pass
243	        self._fsync_dir(directory)

245	    @staticmethod
246	    def _read_candidate(path: str) -> dict:
247	        """Read and JSON-decode one snapshot file.
248	
249	        Any I/O or JSON failure becomes a StateRecoveryError carrying the
250	        offending path, never a silent fall-back.
251	        """
252	        try:
253	            with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
254	                data = json.load(fh)
255	        except OSError as exc:
256	            raise StateRecoveryError(path, f"cannot read file: {exc}") from exc
257	        except (ValueError, UnicodeDecodeError) as exc:
258	            raise StateRecoveryError(path, f"invalid JSON: {exc}") from exc
259	        if not isinstance(data, dict):
260	            raise StateRecoveryError(path, "snapshot root must be a JSON object")
261	        return data

263	    def _parse_snapshot(
264	        self, path: str, data: dict
265	    ) -> tuple[
266	        list[Block],
267	        dict[str, Transaction],
268	        int,
269	        dict[str, list[Block]],
270	        int | None,
271	    ]:
272	        """Strictly validate one decoded snapshot.
273	
274	        Checks the persisted generation, consecutive heights, prev_hash
275	        linkage, recomputed block hashes, recomputed Merkle roots, every
276	        transaction's tx_id and Ed25519 signature, the pending-only-at-tip
277	        rule, and de-duplication between mempool and chain. Returns the parsed
278	        chain, mempool, generation, candidate forks and the recorded initial
279	        balance. Raises StateRecoveryError on the first defect, with ``path``
280	        identifying the candidate.
281	        """
282	        def fail(reason: str) -> None:
283	            raise StateRecoveryError(path, reason)
284	
285	        chain_raw = data.get("chain")
286	        if not isinstance(chain_raw, list) or not chain_raw:
287	            fail("snapshot must contain a non-empty chain")
288	
289	        state = data.get("state")
290	        # A pre-state-section snapshot is accepted: the chain itself is fully
291	        # self-verifying below. A present non-object section is corruption.
292	        if state is None:
293	            state = {}
294	        if not isinstance(state, dict):
295	            fail("invalid 'state' section: must be a JSON object")
296	        generation = state.get("generation", 0)
297	        # bool is an int subclass; reject it explicitly along with negatives.
298	        if isinstance(generation, bool) or not isinstance(generation, int) or generation < 0:
299	            fail("state.generation must be a non-negative integer")
300	        initial_balance = state.get("initial_balance")
301	        if initial_balance is not None and (
302	            isinstance(initial_balance, bool)
303	            or not isinstance(initial_balance, int)
304	            or initial_balance <= 0
305	        ):
306	            fail("state.initial_balance must be a positive integer")
307	
308	        chain: list[Block] = []
309	        seen_tx_ids: set[str] = set()
310	        for i, block_raw in enumerate(chain_raw):
311	            if not isinstance(block_raw, dict):
312	                fail(f"block at position {i} is not a JSON object")
313	            try:
314	                block = Block.from_dict(block_raw)
315	            except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
316	                fail(f"block {i} is malformed: {exc}")
317	            if block.height != i:
318	                fail(
319	                    f"block at position {i} has non-consecutive height "
320	                    f"{block.height}"
321	                )
322	            expected_prev = GENESIS_PREV_HASH if i == 0 else chain[i - 1].block_hash
323	            if block.prev_hash != expected_prev:
324	                fail(f"block {block.height} has a mismatched prev_hash")
325	            if block.status not in (STATUS_PENDING, STATUS_CONFIRMED):
326	                fail(f"block {block.height} has unknown status {block.status!r}")
327	            if i == 0 and (
328	                block.status != STATUS_CONFIRMED or block.transactions
329	            ):
330	                fail("genesis block must be confirmed and carry no transactions")
331	            # Pending blocks may only sit at the chain tip.
332	            if i < len(chain_raw) - 1 and block.status == STATUS_PENDING:
333	                fail(f"pending block {block.height} is not the chain tip")
334	
335	            # Validate every transaction: stored tx_id, recomputed tx_id and
336	            # the Ed25519 signature.
337	            tx_ids: list[str] = []
338	            txs_raw = block_raw.get("transactions")
339	            if not isinstance(txs_raw, list):
340	                fail(f"block {block.height} transactions must be a list")
341	            for j, tx in enumerate(block.transactions):
342	                self._validate_transaction(path, tx)
343	                stored_tx_id = txs_raw[j].get("tx_id") if isinstance(txs_raw[j], dict) else None
344	                if stored_tx_id != tx.tx_id:
345	                    fail(
346	                        f"transaction in block {block.height} has a mismatched "
347	                        f"tx_id (stored {stored_tx_id!r}, recomputed {tx.tx_id})"
348	                    )
349	                if tx.tx_id in seen_tx_ids:
350	                    fail(
351	                        f"duplicate transaction {tx.tx_id} in block "
352	                        f"{block.height}"
353	                    )
354	                seen_tx_ids.add(tx.tx_id)
355	                tx_ids.append(tx.tx_id)
356	            # Blocks store transactions in ascending tx_id order.
357	            if tx_ids != sorted(tx_ids):
358	                fail(f"block {block.height} transactions are not tx_id sorted")
359	
360	            recomputed_merkle = crypto.merkle_root(tx_ids)
361	            if recomputed_merkle != block.merkle_root:
362	                fail(f"block {block.height} Merkle root mismatch")
363	            recomputed_hash = compute_block_hash(
364	                block.height, block.prev_hash, block.merkle_root
365	            )
366	            if recomputed_hash != block.block_hash:
367	                fail(f"block {block.height} block_hash mismatch")
368	            chain.append(block)
369	
370	        # Mempool: well-formed, no internal duplicates, never overlapping the
371	        # chain (neither confirmed nor pending-block transactions).
372	        pending: dict[str, Transaction] = {}
373	        pending_raw = data.get("pending", [])
374	        if not isinstance(pending_raw, list):
375	            fail("'pending' must be a list")
376	        for tx_raw in pending_raw:
377	            if not isinstance(tx_raw, dict):
378	                fail("pending entry is not a JSON object")
379	            try:
380	                tx = Transaction.from_dict(tx_raw)
381	            except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
382	                fail(f"pending transaction is malformed: {exc}")
383	            self._validate_transaction(path, tx)
384	            if tx_raw.get("tx_id") != tx.tx_id:
385	                fail(
386	                    f"pending transaction has a mismatched tx_id (stored "
387	                    f"{tx_raw.get('tx_id')!r}, recomputed {tx.tx_id})"
388	                )
389	            if tx.tx_id in pending:
390	                fail(f"duplicate pending transaction {tx.tx_id} in mempool")
391	            if tx.tx_id in seen_tx_ids:
392	                fail(
393	                    f"pending transaction {tx.tx_id} already exists in a block"
394	                )
395	            pending[tx.tx_id] = tx
396	
397	        # Cross-check the persisted tip summary against the chain tail.
398	        tip = chain[-1]
399	        if state.get("height") is not None and state["height"] != tip.height:
400	            fail("state.height does not match the chain tip")
401	        if state.get("tip_hash") is not None and state["tip_hash"] != tip.block_hash:
402	            fail("state.tip_hash does not match the chain tip")
403	        if (
404	            state.get("tip_status") is not None
405	            and state["tip_status"] != tip.status
406	        ):
407	            fail("state.tip_status does not match the chain tip")
408	
409	        forks = self._parse_persisted_forks(data.get("forks", []), chain)
410	        return chain, pending, generation, forks, initial_balance
411	
412	    @staticmethod
413	    def _validate_transaction(path: str, tx: Transaction) -> None:
414	        """Recompute a transaction's id and check its Ed25519 signature."""
415	        if (
416	            not isinstance(tx.sender, str)
417	            or not isinstance(tx.recipient, str)
418	            or not tx.sender
419	            or not tx.recipient
420	        ):
421	            raise StateRecoveryError(path, "transaction has invalid from/to fields")
422	        if (
423	            isinstance(tx.amount, bool)
424	            or not isinstance(tx.amount, int)
425	            or tx.amount <= 0
426	        ):
427	            raise StateRecoveryError(
428	                path, f"transaction {getattr(tx, 'sender', '?')} has non-positive amount"
429	            )
430	        if not isinstance(tx.signature, str) or not tx.signature:
431	            raise StateRecoveryError(path, "transaction is missing a signature")
432	        if not crypto.verify_signature(tx.sender, tx.message, tx.signature):
433	            raise StateRecoveryError(
434	                path, f"transaction {tx.tx_id} has an invalid signature"
435	            )

447	    def rebuild_derived(self) -> None:
448	        """Rebuild the confirmed-only transaction index and account activity.
449	
450	        Pending blocks are excluded: only confirmed blocks contribute to
451	        balances and to the tx_id -> height index.
452	        """
453	        self.tx_index = {}
454	        self.accounts = {}
455	        for block in self.chain:
456	            if block.status != STATUS_CONFIRMED:
457	                continue
458	            for tx in block.transactions:
459	                self.tx_index[tx.tx_id] = block.height
460	                for account in (tx.sender, tx.recipient):
461	                    entry = self.accounts.setdefault(
462	                        account, {"sent": 0, "received": 0, "transactions": []}
463	                    )
464	                    entry["transactions"].append(tx.tx_id)
465	                self.accounts[tx.sender]["sent"] += tx.amount
466	                self.accounts[tx.recipient]["received"] += tx.amount

468	    def save(self) -> None:
469	        """Atomically persist chain, state, pending set, index and accounts.
470	
471	        The new state is first written to a uniquely named ``.ledger-*``
472	        snapshot in the same directory and force-fsynced; only after that does
473	        an atomic ``os.replace`` promote it to the main file. A crash between
474	        the fsync and the promotion leaves the snapshot behind, where the
475	        startup scan finds it as a recovery candidate. The in-memory
476	        ``generation`` is advanced only after the promotion succeeds, so every
477	        *successful* atomic write corresponds to exactly one generation.
478	        """
479	        self.rebuild_derived()
480	        next_generation = self.generation + 1
481	        data = {
482	            "state": {
483	                "version": STATE_VERSION,
484	                "generation": next_generation,
485	                "height": self.chain[-1].height,
486	                "tip_hash": self.chain[-1].block_hash,
487	                "tip_status": self.chain[-1].status,
488	                "initial_balance": self.initial_balance,
489	            },
490	            "chain": [block.to_dict() for block in self.chain],
491	            "pending": [tx.to_dict() for tx in self.pending.values()],
492	            "index": dict(self.tx_index),
493	            "accounts": self.accounts,
494	        }
495	        # Only persist a forks section when candidates exist so a chain with
496	        # no forks keeps the canonical snapshot layout; loads default to [].
497	        if self.forks:
498	            data["forks"] = [
499	                [block.to_dict() for block in fork]
500	                for fork in sorted(self.forks.values(), key=lambda f: f[-1].block_hash)
501	            ]
502	        directory = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(self.path)) or "."
503	        os.makedirs(directory, exist_ok=True)
504	        # Hold the class-wide recovery lock while a .ledger-* snapshot exists
505	        # on disk, so a concurrent in-process LedgerStore construction cannot
506	        # scan a half-written promotion.
507	        with self._recovery_lock:
508	            fd, tmp_path = tempfile.mkstemp(
509	                prefix=SNAPSHOT_PREFIX,
510	                suffix=f".gen{next_generation}",
511	                dir=directory,
512	            )
513	            promoted = False
514	            try:
515	                with os.fdopen(fd, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
516	                    json.dump(data, fh, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True)
517	                    fh.flush()
518	                    os.fsync(fh.fileno())
519	                os.replace(tmp_path, self.path)
520	                promoted = True
521	                self._fsync_dir(directory)
522	                self.generation = next_generation
523	            finally:
524	                if not promoted and os.path.exists(tmp_path):
525	                    # Promotion never happened: drop the half-written candidate so
526	                    # it cannot masquerade as a recoverable snapshot. A candidate
527	                    # written and fsynced *before* a crash during replace survives
528	                    # precisely because that crash skips this cleanup.
529	                    try:
530	                        os.unlink(tmp_path)
531	                    except OSError:
532	                        pass
533	
534	    @staticmethod
535	    def _fsync_dir(directory: str) -> None:
536	        """Best-effort directory fsync so a rename survives a power loss."""
537	        try:
538	            dir_fd = os.open(directory, os.O_RDONLY | getattr(os, "O_DIRECTORY", 0))
539	        except OSError:
540	            return
541	        try:
542	            os.fsync(dir_fd)
543	        except OSError:
544	            pass
545	        finally:
546	            os.close(dir_fd)

567	    def rollback_tip(self) -> Block:
568	        """Remove the pending tip block and return its transactions to the mempool.
569	
570	        Transactions are restored de-duplicated: an id already present in the
571	        pending set (resubmitted while the block was unconfirmed) is kept as
572	        is, not overwritten. Caller must hold the lock and must have checked
573	        that the tip is a pending block. Does not save; callers persist.

582	    @staticmethod
583	    def _valid_tx_fields(tx: Transaction) -> None:
584	        """Structural checks shared by candidate submission and recovery."""
585	        if not isinstance(tx.sender, str) or not tx.sender:
586	            raise ValueError("transaction has an invalid 'from' field")
587	        if not isinstance(tx.recipient, str) or not tx.recipient:
588	            raise ValueError("transaction has an invalid 'to' field")
589	        if isinstance(tx.amount, bool) or not isinstance(tx.amount, int) or tx.amount <= 0:
590	            raise ValueError("transaction amount must be a positive integer")
591	        if not isinstance(tx.signature, str) or not tx.signature:
592	            raise ValueError("transaction is missing a signature")

594	    def _parse_verified_chain(
595	        self, blocks_raw: object, endowment: int, genesis: Block | None = None
596	    ) -> list[Block]:
597	        """Strictly validate a block list submitted as (or persisted as) a fork.
598	
599	        The list must start from the canonical genesis block, connect through
600	        consecutive heights and prev_hash values, and carry recomputed-correct
601	        Merkle roots and block hashes. Transactions must have valid Ed25519
602	        signatures, ascending and globally unique tx_ids, and a replay from the
603	        per-identity endowment must never overspend. All blocks must be
604	        confirmed except an optional pending tip. Raises ValueError on any
605	        defect.
606	        """
607	        if not isinstance(blocks_raw, list) or not blocks_raw:
608	            raise ValueError("'blocks' must be a non-empty list")
609	        genesis = genesis if genesis is not None else self.chain[0]
610	        blocks: list[Block] = []
611	        seen_tx_ids: set[str] = set()
612	        for i, block_raw in enumerate(blocks_raw):
613	            if not isinstance(block_raw, dict):
614	                raise ValueError(f"block at position {i} is not a JSON object")
615	            try:
616	                block = Block.from_dict(block_raw)
617	            except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
618	                raise ValueError(f"block {i} is malformed: {exc}") from exc
619	            if isinstance(block.height, bool) or block.height != i:
620	                raise ValueError(
621	                    f"block at position {i} has non-consecutive height {block.height}"
622	                )
623	            expected_prev = GENESIS_PREV_HASH if i == 0 else blocks[i - 1].block_hash
624	            if block.prev_hash != expected_prev:
625	                raise ValueError(f"block {i} has a mismatched prev_hash")
626	            if block.status not in (STATUS_PENDING, STATUS_CONFIRMED):
627	                raise ValueError(f"block {i} has unknown status {block.status!r}")
628	            if i == 0:
629	                # The candidate must connect to *the* canonical genesis.
630	                if (
631	                    block.status != STATUS_CONFIRMED
632	                    or block.transactions
633	                    or block.block_hash != genesis.block_hash
634	                    or block.merkle_root != genesis.merkle_root
635	                ):
636	                    raise ValueError("first block must be the canonical genesis block")
637	            elif i < len(blocks_raw) - 1 and block.status == STATUS_PENDING:
638	                raise ValueError(f"pending block {i} is not the chain tip")
639	
640	            txs_raw = block_raw.get("transactions")
641	            if not isinstance(txs_raw, list):
642	                raise ValueError(f"block {i} transactions must be a list")
643	            tx_ids: list[str] = []
644	            for j, tx in enumerate(block.transactions):
645	                self._valid_tx_fields(tx)
646	                if not crypto.verify_signature(tx.sender, tx.message, tx.signature):
647	                    raise ValueError(f"block {i} transaction {j} has an invalid signature")
648	                stored_id = txs_raw[j].get("tx_id") if isinstance(txs_raw[j], dict) else None
649	                if stored_id != tx.tx_id:
650	                    raise ValueError(
651	                        f"block {i} transaction {j} has a mismatched tx_id"
652	                    )
653	                if tx.tx_id in seen_tx_ids:
654	                    raise ValueError(f"duplicate transaction {tx.tx_id} in candidate")
655	                seen_tx_ids.add(tx.tx_id)
656	                tx_ids.append(tx.tx_id)
657	            if tx_ids != sorted(tx_ids):
658	                raise ValueError(f"block {i} transactions are not tx_id sorted")
659	            if crypto.merkle_root(tx_ids) != block.merkle_root:
660	                raise ValueError(f"block {i} Merkle root mismatch")
661	            if (
662	                compute_block_hash(block.height, block.prev_hash, block.merkle_root)
663	                != block.block_hash
664	            ):
665	                raise ValueError(f"block {i} block_hash mismatch")
666	            blocks.append(block)
667	
668	        # Replay every transaction from the per-identity endowment; unconfirmed
669	        # (pending tip) transactions are included so a candidate can never hide
670	        # an overspend behind a pending final block.
671	        balances: dict[str, int] = {}
672	        for block in blocks:
673	            for tx in block.transactions:
674	                sender_balance = balances.get(tx.sender, endowment)
675	                if sender_balance < tx.amount:
676	                    raise ValueError(
677	                        f"replay overspend by {tx.sender} in block {block.height}"
678	                    )
679	                balances[tx.sender] = sender_balance - tx.amount
680	                balances[tx.recipient] = balances.get(tx.recipient, endowment) + tx.amount
681	        return blocks
682	
683	    def validate_fork_blocks(self, blocks_raw: object) -> list[Block]:
684	        """Validate and parse a candidate fork submitted by a client.
685	
686	        The blocks must start from the canonical genesis block, connect via
687	        consecutive heights and prev_hash, carry correct block hashes and
688	        Merkle roots, unique ascending tx_ids with valid Ed25519 signatures and
689	        no replay overspend, and be all confirmed except an optional pending
690	        tip. Raises ValueError with a descriptive reason on any defect.
691	        """
692	        endowment = (
693	            self.initial_balance if self.initial_balance is not None else 1_000_000
694	        )
695	        return self._parse_verified_chain(blocks_raw, endowment)

697	    def _parse_persisted_forks(
698	        self, forks_raw: object, canonical_chain: list[Block]
699	    ) -> dict[str, list[Block]]:
700	        """Parse persisted candidate forks, dropping invalid ones on restart.
701	
702	        Every stored fork is re-validated exactly like a fresh submission
703	        (genesis connection, hashes, Merkle roots, signatures, uniqueness,
704	        replay). A fork that no longer validates is silently discarded rather
705	        than failing recovery of the canonical chain. Recovery of the canonical

"""Persistent storage: blockchain, pending set and derived indexes (JSON).

The whole state is one JSON document written atomically: a uniquely named
``.ledger-*`` snapshot is fsynced in the same directory and then promoted over
the main file with ``os.replace`` (followed by a directory fsync). Every
successful write advances a monotonic ``generation`` recorded in the
snapshot. A crash can therefore only leave behind (a) the previous main file
or (b) a fully fsynced snapshot that never got renamed — never a torn file.

On startup the main file and every sibling ``.ledger-*`` snapshot are treated
as recovery candidates. When no file exists at all, the unique genesis block
is created; otherwise each candidate is strictly validated (JSON, generation,
consecutive heights, prev_hash linkage, recomputed block hashes and Merkle
roots, per-transaction tx_id and Ed25519 signature, pending-only-at-tip and
mempool/chain de-duplication). The valid snapshot with the highest generation
wins and is promoted if it is still a temp file; same-generation content
conflicts, or a directory with no valid candidate, raise StateRecoveryError
with the offending path and reason — a fresh chain is never silently created.

One atomic write persists everything: the chain (each block carries its
confirm/rollback ``status``), a small ``state`` summary, the mempool
(``pending``), candidate fork chains (``forks``, each a full block list
anchored at the canonical genesis and keyed by its tip hash), the
confirmed-transaction ``index`` and the confirmed ``accounts`` activity.
Derived data (index/accounts) is *rebuilt* from the chain on every load and
every save — pending blocks are excluded, so a restart never resurrects
unconfirmed transactions into balances. Persisted fork candidates are
re-validated on startup and invalid ones are dropped, while canonical-chain
invalidity remains fatal. A re-entrant lock serializes all updates, and a
class-wide recovery lock serializes startup scans against in-flight writes.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import tempfile
import threading

from .models import (
    STATUS_CONFIRMED,
    STATUS_PENDING,
    Block,
    Transaction,
    compute_block_hash,
)
from . import crypto

# Previous hash of the genesis block.
GENESIS_PREV_HASH = "0" * 64

# On-disk schema version, stored under "state" so future migrations are possible.
STATE_VERSION = 4

# Prefix of durable snapshot temp files ("<state>.ledger-<...>") living next to
# the main state file. They double as crash-recovery candidates on startup.
SNAPSHOT_PREFIX = ".ledger-"


class StateRecoveryError(ValueError):
    """Raised when no usable on-disk state can be recovered on startup.

    Carries the candidate ``path`` that failed and a human-readable ``reason``
    so callers can report (or catch) the failure explicitly. The exception is a
    ``ValueError`` subclass, so older callers expecting ``ValueError`` on a
    corrupt state file keep working.
    """

    def __init__(self, path: str, reason: str) -> None:
        self.path = path
        self.reason = reason
        super().__init__(f"cannot recover ledger state from {path}: {reason}")


class LedgerStore:
    def __init__(self, path: str, initial_balance: int | None = None) -> None:
        self.path = path
        self.chain: list[Block] = []
        self.pending: dict[str, Transaction] = {}
        # Candidate fork chains keyed by tip block hash. Each value is the
        # fork's full block list (including the shared genesis block).
        self.forks: dict[str, list[Block]] = {}
        # Per-identity endowment used for candidate replay checks; recorded in
        # the snapshot so recovery validates against the same convention.
        self.initial_balance: int | None = initial_balance
        # Monotonic counter bumped on every successful atomic write. It is
        # persisted with each snapshot and lets startup pick the newest one.
        self.generation: int = 0
        # Derived, confirmed-only views; rebuilt by rebuild_derived().
        self.tx_index: dict[str, int] = {}
        self.accounts: dict[str, dict] = {}
        self._lock = threading.RLock()
        self.load()

    @property
    def lock(self) -> threading.RLock:
        return self._lock

    # Serializes startup scans/promotions between threads (or two store
    # instances on the same path) within one process. All later mutations take
    # the per-store re-entrant lock.
    _recovery_lock = threading.RLock()

    def load(self) -> None:
        """Recover state from disk on startup.

        The main file *and* every sibling ``.ledger-*`` snapshot are treated
        as recovery candidates. When none exist at all, the unique genesis
        block is created (the established first-start convention); otherwise
        every candidate is strictly validated and the valid snapshot with the
        highest generation wins. A winning temp snapshot is atomically
        promoted over the main file and every judged-older or residual
        candidate is removed. Same-generation snapshots with conflicting
        content, or a directory with no valid candidate, raise
        StateRecoveryError — a fresh chain is never silently created.
        """
        directory = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(self.path)) or "."
        with self._recovery_lock:
            candidates = self._discover_candidates(directory)
            if not candidates:
                os.makedirs(directory, exist_ok=True)
                self.chain = [self.create_genesis()]
                self.pending = {}
                self.forks = {}
                self.generation = 0
                self.rebuild_derived()
                self.save()
                return

            valid: list[tuple] = []
            errors: list[StateRecoveryError] = []
            for candidate in candidates:
                try:
                    data = self._read_candidate(candidate)
                    parsed = self._parse_snapshot(candidate, data)
                except StateRecoveryError as exc:
                    errors.append(exc)
                    continue
                valid.append(
                    (parsed[2], candidate, parsed[0], parsed[1], parsed[3], parsed[4])
                )

            if not valid:
                details = "; ".join(f"{exc.path} ({exc.reason})" for exc in errors)
                raise StateRecoveryError(
                    directory, f"no valid snapshot candidate found: {details}"
                )

            max_generation = max(item[0] for item in valid)
            top = [item for item in valid if item[0] == max_generation]
            reference = self._canonical_view(top[0][2], top[0][3], top[0][4])
            for item in top[1:]:
                if self._canonical_view(item[2], item[3], item[4]) != reference:
                    paths = " vs ".join(item[1] for item in top)
                    raise StateRecoveryError(
                        directory,
                        f"conflicting snapshots at generation {max_generation}: {paths}",
                    )

            # Identical same-generation snapshots: keep the main file when it
            # is one of them, avoiding a pointless promotion cycle.
            main_abs = os.path.abspath(self.path)
            winner = top[0]
            for item in top:
                if os.path.abspath(item[1]) == main_abs:
                    winner = item
                    break
            generation, winner_path, chain, pending, forks, winner_init_balance = winner

            if os.path.abspath(winner_path) != main_abs:
                # The newest durable state only ever made it to a temp
                # snapshot (a crash interrupted the promotion): promote it.
                os.replace(winner_path, self.path)
                self._fsync_dir(directory)

            self.chain = chain
            self.pending = pending
            self.forks = forks
            self.generation = generation
            # Prefer the endowment recorded by the writer; fall back to the
            # value this instance was constructed with, and finally to the
            # service default, so older snapshots without the field still
            # validate fork replays against the configured endowment.
            if winner_init_balance is not None:
                self.initial_balance = winner_init_balance
            self.rebuild_derived()
            self._cleanup_candidates(directory)

    def _discover_candidates(self, directory: str) -> list[str]:
        """List the main file and sibling .ledger-* snapshots (if any)."""
        candidates: list[str] = []
        if os.path.exists(self.path):
            candidates.append(self.path)
        try:
            names = sorted(os.listdir(directory))
        except OSError:
            return candidates
        main_name = os.path.basename(self.path)
        for name in names:
            if name == main_name or not name.startswith(SNAPSHOT_PREFIX):
                continue
            full = os.path.join(directory, name)
            if os.path.isfile(full):
                candidates.append(full)
        return candidates

    @staticmethod
    def _canonical_view(
        chain: list[Block],
        pending: dict[str, Transaction],
        forks: dict[str, list[Block]],
    ) -> str:
        """Order-independent canonical content hash for conflict detection."""
        return json.dumps(
            {
                "chain": [block.to_dict() for block in chain],
                "pending": [pending[tx_id].to_dict() for tx_id in sorted(pending)],
                "forks": [
                    [block.to_dict() for block in forks[tip]]
                    for tip in sorted(forks)
                ],
            },
            sort_keys=True,
            ensure_ascii=False,
        )

    def _cleanup_candidates(self, directory: str) -> None:
        """Remove every residual .ledger-* snapshot next to the main file.

        After recovery these are by definition unusable leftovers: older
        generations, an identical post-promotion residue, or a partially
        written (invalid) file. The promoted/main state is never touched.
        """
        main_name = os.path.basename(self.path)
        for name in list(os.listdir(directory)):
            if not name.startswith(SNAPSHOT_PREFIX) or name == main_name:
                continue
            full = os.path.join(directory, name)
            try:
                if os.path.isfile(full) or os.path.islink(full):
                    os.unlink(full)
            except OSError:
                pass
        self._fsync_dir(directory)

    @staticmethod
    def _read_candidate(path: str) -> dict:
        """Read and JSON-decode one snapshot file.

        Any I/O or JSON failure becomes a StateRecoveryError carrying the
        offending path, never a silent fall-back.
        """
        try:
            with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
                data = json.load(fh)
        except OSError as exc:
            raise StateRecoveryError(path, f"cannot read file: {exc}") from exc
        except (ValueError, UnicodeDecodeError) as exc:
            raise StateRecoveryError(path, f"invalid JSON: {exc}") from exc
        if not isinstance(data, dict):
            raise StateRecoveryError(path, "snapshot root must be a JSON object")
        return data

    def _parse_snapshot(
        self, path: str, data: dict
    ) -> tuple[
        list[Block],
        dict[str, Transaction],
        int,
        dict[str, list[Block]],
        int | None,
    ]:
        """Strictly validate one decoded snapshot.

        Checks the persisted generation, consecutive heights, prev_hash
        linkage, recomputed block hashes, recomputed Merkle roots, every
        transaction's tx_id and Ed25519 signature, the pending-only-at-tip
        rule, and de-duplication between mempool and chain. Returns the parsed
        chain, mempool, generation, candidate forks and the recorded initial
        balance. Raises StateRecoveryError on the first defect, with ``path``
        identifying the candidate.
        """
        def fail(reason: str) -> None:
            raise StateRecoveryError(path, reason)

        chain_raw = data.get("chain")
        if not isinstance(chain_raw, list) or not chain_raw:
            fail("snapshot must contain a non-empty chain")

        state = data.get("state")
        # A pre-state-section snapshot is accepted: the chain itself is fully
        # self-verifying below. A present non-object section is corruption.
        if state is None:
            state = {}
        if not isinstance(state, dict):
            fail("invalid 'state' section: must be a JSON object")
        generation = state.get("generation", 0)
        # bool is an int subclass; reject it explicitly along with negatives.
        if isinstance(generation, bool) or not isinstance(generation, int) or generation < 0:
            fail("state.generation must be a non-negative integer")
        initial_balance = state.get("initial_balance")
        if initial_balance is not None and (
            isinstance(initial_balance, bool)
            or not isinstance(initial_balance, int)
            or initial_balance <= 0
        ):
            fail("state.initial_balance must be a positive integer")

        chain: list[Block] = []
        seen_tx_ids: set[str] = set()
        for i, block_raw in enumerate(chain_raw):
            if not isinstance(block_raw, dict):
                fail(f"block at position {i} is not a JSON object")
            try:
                block = Block.from_dict(block_raw)
            except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
                fail(f"block {i} is malformed: {exc}")
            if block.height != i:
                fail(
                    f"block at position {i} has non-consecutive height "
                    f"{block.height}"
                )
            expected_prev = GENESIS_PREV_HASH if i == 0 else chain[i - 1].block_hash
            if block.prev_hash != expected_prev:
                fail(f"block {block.height} has a mismatched prev_hash")
            if block.status not in (STATUS_PENDING, STATUS_CONFIRMED):
                fail(f"block {block.height} has unknown status {block.status!r}")
            if i == 0 and (
                block.status != STATUS_CONFIRMED or block.transactions
            ):
                fail("genesis block must be confirmed and carry no transactions")
            # Pending blocks may only sit at the chain tip.
            if i < len(chain_raw) - 1 and block.status == STATUS_PENDING:
                fail(f"pending block {block.height} is not the chain tip")

            # Validate every transaction: stored tx_id, recomputed tx_id and
            # the Ed25519 signature.
            tx_ids: list[str] = []
            txs_raw = block_raw.get("transactions")
            if not isinstance(txs_raw, list):
                fail(f"block {block.height} transactions must be a list")
            for j, tx in enumerate(block.transactions):
                self._validate_transaction(path, tx)
                stored_tx_id = txs_raw[j].get("tx_id") if isinstance(txs_raw[j], dict) else None
                if stored_tx_id != tx.tx_id:
                    fail(
                        f"transaction in block {block.height} has a mismatched "
                        f"tx_id (stored {stored_tx_id!r}, recomputed {tx.tx_id})"
                    )
                if tx.tx_id in seen_tx_ids:
                    fail(
                        f"duplicate transaction {tx.tx_id} in block "
                        f"{block.height}"
                    )
                seen_tx_ids.add(tx.tx_id)
                tx_ids.append(tx.tx_id)
            # Blocks store transactions in ascending tx_id order.
            if tx_ids != sorted(tx_ids):
                fail(f"block {block.height} transactions are not tx_id sorted")

            recomputed_merkle = crypto.merkle_root(tx_ids)
            if recomputed_merkle != block.merkle_root:
                fail(f"block {block.height} Merkle root mismatch")
            recomputed_hash = compute_block_hash(
                block.height, block.prev_hash, block.merkle_root
            )
            if recomputed_hash != block.block_hash:
                fail(f"block {block.height} block_hash mismatch")
            chain.append(block)

        # Mempool: well-formed, no internal duplicates, never overlapping the
        # chain (neither confirmed nor pending-block transactions).
        pending: dict[str, Transaction] = {}
        pending_raw = data.get("pending", [])
        if not isinstance(pending_raw, list):
            fail("'pending' must be a list")
        for tx_raw in pending_raw:
            if not isinstance(tx_raw, dict):
                fail("pending entry is not a JSON object")
            try:
                tx = Transaction.from_dict(tx_raw)
            except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
                fail(f"pending transaction is malformed: {exc}")
            self._validate_transaction(path, tx)
            if tx_raw.get("tx_id") != tx.tx_id:
                fail(
                    f"pending transaction has a mismatched tx_id (stored "
                    f"{tx_raw.get('tx_id')!r}, recomputed {tx.tx_id})"
                )
            if tx.tx_id in pending:
                fail(f"duplicate pending transaction {tx.tx_id} in mempool")
            if tx.tx_id in seen_tx_ids:
                fail(
                    f"pending transaction {tx.tx_id} already exists in a block"
                )
            pending[tx.tx_id] = tx

        # Cross-check the persisted tip summary against the chain tail.
        tip = chain[-1]
        if state.get("height") is not None and state["height"] != tip.height:
            fail("state.height does not match the chain tip")
        if state.get("tip_hash") is not None and state["tip_hash"] != tip.block_hash:
            fail("state.tip_hash does not match the chain tip")
        if (
            state.get("tip_status") is not None
            and state["tip_status"] != tip.status
        ):
            fail("state.tip_status does not match the chain tip")

        forks = self._parse_persisted_forks(data.get("forks", []), chain)
        return chain, pending, generation, forks, initial_balance

    @staticmethod
    def _validate_transaction(path: str, tx: Transaction) -> None:
        """Recompute a transaction's id and check its Ed25519 signature."""
        if (
            not isinstance(tx.sender, str)
            or not isinstance(tx.recipient, str)
            or not tx.sender
            or not tx.recipient
        ):
            raise StateRecoveryError(path, "transaction has invalid from/to fields")
        if (
            isinstance(tx.amount, bool)
            or not isinstance(tx.amount, int)
            or tx.amount <= 0
        ):
            raise StateRecoveryError(
                path, f"transaction {getattr(tx, 'sender', '?')} has non-positive amount"
            )
        if not isinstance(tx.signature, str) or not tx.signature:
            raise StateRecoveryError(path, "transaction is missing a signature")
        if not crypto.verify_signature(tx.sender, tx.message, tx.signature):
            raise StateRecoveryError(
                path, f"transaction {tx.tx_id} has an invalid signature"
            )

    @staticmethod
    def create_genesis() -> Block:
        # The genesis block is born confirmed.
        return Block.create(
            height=0,
            prev_hash=GENESIS_PREV_HASH,
            transactions=[],
            status=STATUS_CONFIRMED,
        )

    def rebuild_derived(self) -> None:
        """Rebuild the confirmed-only transaction index and account activity.

        Pending blocks are excluded: only confirmed blocks contribute to
        balances and to the tx_id -> height index.
        """
        self.tx_index = {}
        self.accounts = {}
        for block in self.chain:
            if block.status != STATUS_CONFIRMED:
                continue
            for tx in block.transactions:
                self.tx_index[tx.tx_id] = block.height
                for account in (tx.sender, tx.recipient):
                    entry = self.accounts.setdefault(
                        account, {"sent": 0, "received": 0, "transactions": []}
                    )
                    entry["transactions"].append(tx.tx_id)
                self.accounts[tx.sender]["sent"] += tx.amount
                self.accounts[tx.recipient]["received"] += tx.amount

    def save(self) -> None:
        """Atomically persist chain, state, pending set, index and accounts.

        The new state is first written to a uniquely named ``.ledger-*``
        snapshot in the same directory and force-fsynced; only after that does
        an atomic ``os.replace`` promote it to the main file. A crash between
        the fsync and the promotion leaves the snapshot behind, where the
        startup scan finds it as a recovery candidate. The in-memory
        ``generation`` is advanced only after the promotion succeeds, so every
        *successful* atomic write corresponds to exactly one generation.
        """
        self.rebuild_derived()
        next_generation = self.generation + 1
        data = {
            "state": {
                "version": STATE_VERSION,
                "generation": next_generation,
                "height": self.chain[-1].height,
                "tip_hash": self.chain[-1].block_hash,
                "tip_status": self.chain[-1].status,
                "initial_balance": self.initial_balance,
            },
            "chain": [block.to_dict() for block in self.chain],
            "pending": [tx.to_dict() for tx in self.pending.values()],
            "index": dict(self.tx_index),
            "accounts": self.accounts,
        }
        # Only persist a forks section when candidates exist so a chain with
        # no forks keeps the canonical snapshot layout; loads default to [].
        if self.forks:
            data["forks"] = [
                [block.to_dict() for block in fork]
                for fork in sorted(self.forks.values(), key=lambda f: f[-1].block_hash)
            ]
        directory = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(self.path)) or "."
        os.makedirs(directory, exist_ok=True)
        # Hold the class-wide recovery lock while a .ledger-* snapshot exists
        # on disk, so a concurrent in-process LedgerStore construction cannot
        # scan a half-written promotion.
        with self._recovery_lock:
            fd, tmp_path = tempfile.mkstemp(
                prefix=SNAPSHOT_PREFIX,
                suffix=f".gen{next_generation}",
                dir=directory,
            )
            promoted = False
            try:
                with os.fdopen(fd, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
                    json.dump(data, fh, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True)
                    fh.flush()
                    os.fsync(fh.fileno())
                os.replace(tmp_path, self.path)
                promoted = True
                self._fsync_dir(directory)
                self.generation = next_generation
            finally:
                if not promoted and os.path.exists(tmp_path):
                    # Promotion never happened: drop the half-written candidate so
                    # it cannot masquerade as a recoverable snapshot. A candidate
                    # written and fsynced *before* a crash during replace survives
                    # precisely because that crash skips this cleanup.
                    try:
                        os.unlink(tmp_path)
                    except OSError:
                        pass

    @staticmethod
    def _fsync_dir(directory: str) -> None:
        """Best-effort directory fsync so a rename survives a power loss."""
        try:
            dir_fd = os.open(directory, os.O_RDONLY | getattr(os, "O_DIRECTORY", 0))
        except OSError:
            return
        try:
            os.fsync(dir_fd)
        except OSError:
            pass
        finally:
            os.close(dir_fd)

    # -- chain helpers --------------------------------------------------------

    def tip(self) -> Block:
        return self.chain[-1]

    def tip_hash(self) -> str:
        return self.chain[-1].block_hash

    def next_height(self) -> int:
        return self.chain[-1].height + 1

    def tip_is_pending(self) -> bool:
        return self.chain[-1].status == STATUS_PENDING

    def block_at(self, height: int) -> Block | None:
        if 0 <= height < len(self.chain) and self.chain[height].height == height:
            return self.chain[height]
        return None

    def rollback_tip(self) -> Block:
        """Remove the pending tip block and return its transactions to the mempool.

        Transactions are restored de-duplicated: an id already present in the
        pending set (resubmitted while the block was unconfirmed) is kept as
        is, not overwritten. Caller must hold the lock and must have checked
        that the tip is a pending block. Does not save; callers persist.
        """
        block = self.chain.pop()
        for tx in block.transactions:
            self.pending.setdefault(tx.tx_id, tx)
        return block

    # -- fork candidates ------------------------------------------------------

    @staticmethod
    def _valid_tx_fields(tx: Transaction) -> None:
        """Structural checks shared by candidate submission and recovery."""
        if not isinstance(tx.sender, str) or not tx.sender:
            raise ValueError("transaction has an invalid 'from' field")
        if not isinstance(tx.recipient, str) or not tx.recipient:
            raise ValueError("transaction has an invalid 'to' field")
        if isinstance(tx.amount, bool) or not isinstance(tx.amount, int) or tx.amount <= 0:
            raise ValueError("transaction amount must be a positive integer")
        if not isinstance(tx.signature, str) or not tx.signature:
            raise ValueError("transaction is missing a signature")

    def _parse_verified_chain(
        self, blocks_raw: object, endowment: int, genesis: Block | None = None
    ) -> list[Block]:
        """Strictly validate a block list submitted as (or persisted as) a fork.

        The list must start from the canonical genesis block, connect through
        consecutive heights and prev_hash values, and carry recomputed-correct
        Merkle roots and block hashes. Transactions must have valid Ed25519
        signatures, ascending and globally unique tx_ids, and a replay from the
        per-identity endowment must never overspend. All blocks must be
        confirmed except an optional pending tip. Raises ValueError on any
        defect.
        """
        if not isinstance(blocks_raw, list) or not blocks_raw:
            raise ValueError("'blocks' must be a non-empty list")
        genesis = genesis if genesis is not None else self.chain[0]
        blocks: list[Block] = []
        seen_tx_ids: set[str] = set()
        for i, block_raw in enumerate(blocks_raw):
            if not isinstance(block_raw, dict):
                raise ValueError(f"block at position {i} is not a JSON object")
            try:
                block = Block.from_dict(block_raw)
            except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
                raise ValueError(f"block {i} is malformed: {exc}") from exc
            if isinstance(block.height, bool) or block.height != i:
                raise ValueError(
                    f"block at position {i} has non-consecutive height {block.height}"
                )
            expected_prev = GENESIS_PREV_HASH if i == 0 else blocks[i - 1].block_hash
            if block.prev_hash != expected_prev:
                raise ValueError(f"block {i} has a mismatched prev_hash")
            if block.status not in (STATUS_PENDING, STATUS_CONFIRMED):
                raise ValueError(f"block {i} has unknown status {block.status!r}")
            if i == 0:
                # The candidate must connect to *the* canonical genesis.
                if (
                    block.status != STATUS_CONFIRMED
                    or block.transactions
                    or block.block_hash != genesis.block_hash
                    or block.merkle_root != genesis.merkle_root
                ):
                    raise ValueError("first block must be the canonical genesis block")
            elif i < len(blocks_raw) - 1 and block.status == STATUS_PENDING:
                raise ValueError(f"pending block {i} is not the chain tip")

            txs_raw = block_raw.get("transactions")
            if not isinstance(txs_raw, list):
                raise ValueError(f"block {i} transactions must be a list")
            tx_ids: list[str] = []
            for j, tx in enumerate(block.transactions):
                self._valid_tx_fields(tx)
                if not crypto.verify_signature(tx.sender, tx.message, tx.signature):
                    raise ValueError(f"block {i} transaction {j} has an invalid signature")
                stored_id = txs_raw[j].get("tx_id") if isinstance(txs_raw[j], dict) else None
                if stored_id != tx.tx_id:
                    raise ValueError(
                        f"block {i} transaction {j} has a mismatched tx_id"
                    )
                if tx.tx_id in seen_tx_ids:
                    raise ValueError(f"duplicate transaction {tx.tx_id} in candidate")
                seen_tx_ids.add(tx.tx_id)
                tx_ids.append(tx.tx_id)
            if tx_ids != sorted(tx_ids):
                raise ValueError(f"block {i} transactions are not tx_id sorted")
            if crypto.merkle_root(tx_ids) != block.merkle_root:
                raise ValueError(f"block {i} Merkle root mismatch")
            if (
                compute_block_hash(block.height, block.prev_hash, block.merkle_root)
                != block.block_hash
            ):
                raise ValueError(f"block {i} block_hash mismatch")
            blocks.append(block)

        # Replay every transaction from the per-identity endowment; unconfirmed
        # (pending tip) transactions are included so a candidate can never hide
        # an overspend behind a pending final block.
        balances: dict[str, int] = {}
        for block in blocks:
            for tx in block.transactions:
                sender_balance = balances.get(tx.sender, endowment)
                if sender_balance < tx.amount:
                    raise ValueError(
                        f"replay overspend by {tx.sender} in block {block.height}"
                    )
                balances[tx.sender] = sender_balance - tx.amount
                balances[tx.recipient] = balances.get(tx.recipient, endowment) + tx.amount
        return blocks

    def validate_fork_blocks(self, blocks_raw: object) -> list[Block]:
        """Validate and parse a candidate fork submitted by a client.

        The blocks must start from the canonical genesis block, connect via
        consecutive heights and prev_hash, carry correct block hashes and
        Merkle roots, unique ascending tx_ids with valid Ed25519 signatures and
        no replay overspend, and be all confirmed except an optional pending
        tip. Raises ValueError with a descriptive reason on any defect.
        """
        endowment = (
            self.initial_balance if self.initial_balance is not None else 1_000_000
        )
        return self._parse_verified_chain(blocks_raw, endowment)

    def _parse_persisted_forks(
        self, forks_raw: object, canonical_chain: list[Block]
    ) -> dict[str, list[Block]]:
        """Parse persisted candidate forks, dropping invalid ones on restart.

        Every stored fork is re-validated exactly like a fresh submission
        (genesis connection, hashes, Merkle roots, signatures, uniqueness,
        replay). A fork that no longer validates is silently discarded rather
        than failing recovery of the canonical chain. Recovery of the canonical
        chain itself remains strict and still raises StateRecoveryError.
        """
        if not isinstance(forks_raw, list):
            return {}
        endowment = self.initial_balance if self.initial_balance is not None else 1_000_000
        genesis = canonical_chain[0]
        forks: dict[str, list[Block]] = {}
        for entry in forks_raw:
            try:
                fork = self._parse_verified_chain(entry, endowment, genesis)
            except (ValueError, KeyError, TypeError):
                continue
            if not fork or fork[0].block_hash != genesis.block_hash:
                continue
            tip_hash = fork[-1].block_hash
            # The canonical chain (or a strict prefix of it, matched by any
            # canonical block hash) is never also stored as a candidate.
            if any(tip_hash == block.block_hash for block in canonical_chain):
                continue
            forks.setdefault(tip_hash, fork)
        return forks

    def replace_chain(self, new_chain: list[Block]) -> None:
        """Atomically adopt a fork: swap the canonical chain, reconcile the
        mempool (old-chain-only confirmed transactions return de-duplicated;
        pending-block transactions never enter the pool) and rebuild indexes.
        Does not save; the caller persists.
        """
        old_confirmed_ids = {
            tx.tx_id
            for block in self.chain
            if block.status == STATUS_CONFIRMED
            for tx in block.transactions
        }
        new_ids = {tx.tx_id for block in new_chain for tx in block.transactions}
        old_tx_by_id = {
            tx.tx_id: tx
            for block in self.chain
            for tx in block.transactions
        }
        # Transactions unique to the superseded chain's confirmed history go
        # back to the mempool, de-duplicated against anything already queued.
        # Transactions from the old pending tip are not in old_confirmed_ids,
        # so they are dropped, never re-enqueued.
        for tx_id in old_confirmed_ids - new_ids:
            self.pending.setdefault(tx_id, old_tx_by_id[tx_id])
        # Transactions now on the adopted chain must leave the mempool.
        for tx_id in new_ids:
            self.pending.pop(tx_id, None)
        self.chain = new_chain
        self.rebuild_derived()

1	"""HTTP server exposing the ledger REST API using the Python standard library."""
2	from __future__ import annotations
3	
4	import json
5	from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
6	from urllib.parse import unquote
7	
8	from .service import LedgerService
9	
10	MAX_BODY_BYTES = 1 << 20  # 1 MiB cap on request bodies
11	
12	
13	def build_handler(service: LedgerService) -> type[BaseHTTPRequestHandler]:
14	    """Create a handler class closed over the given ledger service."""
15	
16	    class LedgerHandler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
17	        server_version = "VerifiableLedger/1.0"
18	
19	        # -- helpers --------------------------------------------------------
20	
21	        def _send_json(self, status: int, body: dict) -> None:
22	            data = json.dumps(body, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True).encode("utf-8")
23	            self.send_response(status)
24	            self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
25	            self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(data)))
26	            self.end_headers()
27	            self.wfile.write(data)
28	
29	        def _read_json(self) -> tuple[bool, object]:
30	            try:
31	                length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length", "0"))
32	            except ValueError:
33	                return False, {"error": "invalid Content-Length"}
34	            if length <= 0:
35	                return False, {"error": "request body must be JSON"}
36	            if length > MAX_BODY_BYTES:
37	                return False, {"error": "request body too large"}
38	            raw = self.rfile.read(length)
39	            try:
40	                return True, json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8"))
41	            except (ValueError, UnicodeDecodeError):
42	                return False, {"error": "request body must be valid JSON"}
43	
44	        # -- routing --------------------------------------------------------
45	
46	        def do_POST(self) -> None:  # noqa: N802 (stdlib naming)
47	            path = self.path.split("?", 1)[0]
48	            if path == "/v1/transactions":
49	                ok, payload = self._read_json()
50	                if not ok:
51	                    self._send_json(400, payload)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
52	                    return
53	                status, body = service.submit_transaction(payload)
54	                self._send_json(status, body)
55	            elif path == "/v1/forks/candidates":
56	                ok, payload = self._read_json()
57	                if not ok:
58	                    self._send_json(400, payload)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
59	                    return
60	                status, body = service.submit_fork_candidate(payload)
61	                self._send_json(status, body)
62	            elif path.startswith("/v1/forks/") and path.endswith("/adopt"):
63	                # POST /v1/forks/{tip_hash}/adopt — a body is not required.
64	                if self.headers.get("Content-Length"):
65	                    self._read_json()
66	                tip_hash = unquote(path[len("/v1/forks/") : -len("/adopt")])
67	                status, body = service.adopt_fork(tip_hash)
68	                self._send_json(status, body)
69	            elif path == "/v1/blocks":
70	                # A body is not required; drain one if present.
71	                if self.headers.get("Content-Length"):
72	                    self._read_json()
73	                status, body = service.mine_block()
74	                self._send_json(status, body)
75	            elif path.startswith("/v1/blocks/"):
76	                remainder = path[len("/v1/blocks/") :]
77	                # POST /v1/blocks/{height}/confirm | /v1/blocks/{height}/rollback
78	                if self.headers.get("Content-Length"):
79	                    self._read_json()
80	                if remainder.endswith("/confirm"):
81	                    height = unquote(remainder[: -len("/confirm")])
82	                    status, body = service.confirm_block(height)
83	                elif remainder.endswith("/rollback"):
84	                    height = unquote(remainder[: -len("/rollback")])
85	                    status, body = service.rollback_block(height)
86	                else:
87	                    status, body = 404, {"error": "not found"}
88	                self._send_json(status, body)
89	            else:
90	                self._send_json(404, {"error": "not found"})
91	
92	        def do_GET(self) -> None:  # noqa: N802 (stdlib naming)
93	            path = self.path.split("?", 1)[0]
94	            if path == "/v1/chain":
95	                status, body = service.get_chain()
96	                self._send_json(status, body)
97	            elif path.startswith("/v1/blocks/"):
98	                remainder = path[len("/v1/blocks/") :]
99	                if "/proof/" in remainder:
100	                    # GET /v1/blocks/{height}/proof/{tx_id}
101	                    height_raw, tx_raw = remainder.split("/proof/", 1)
102	                    if not height_raw or not tx_raw:
103	                        self._send_json(404, {"error": "not found"})
104	                        return
105	                    status, body = service.get_proof(unquote(height_raw), unquote(tx_raw))
106	                    self._send_json(status, body)
107	                elif remainder.endswith("/status"):
108	                    # GET /v1/blocks/{height}/status
109	                    height = unquote(remainder[: -len("/status")])
110	                    status, body = service.get_block_status(height)
111	                    self._send_json(status, body)
112	                else:
113	                    height = unquote(remainder)
114	                    status, body = service.get_block(height)
115	                    self._send_json(status, body)
116	            elif path.startswith("/v1/accounts/"):
117	                account = unquote(path[len("/v1/accounts/") :])
118	                if not account:
119	                    self._send_json(404, {"error": "account not found"})
120	                    return
121	                status, body = service.get_account(account)
122	                self._send_json(status, body)
123	            else:
124	                self._send_json(404, {"error": "not found"})
125	
126	    return LedgerHandler
127	
128	
129	def serve(service: LedgerService, host: str, port: int) -> ThreadingHTTPServer:
130	    """Create and run the HTTP server (blocks until interrupted)."""
131	    httpd = ThreadingHTTPServer((host, port), build_handler(service))
132	    httpd.serve_forever()
133	    return httpd
